metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Roshagni
metas.description: Roshagni is an action revenge drama featuring breathtaking real stunts. The film's protagonist is driven by a quest for vengeance, navigating a story filled with intense action and drama.

metas.name: Modala thedi
metas.description: Sivagnanam works as a bank clerk. Though his pay is meagre, he deals with a lot of cash at the bank. His family consists of his wife Lakshmi, a daughter whose marriage is being negotiated and two school going children. The bank where he works crashes and Sivagnanam is unable to find another job.

metas.name: Anna Thangi
metas.description: Two siblings turn inseparable after the death of their parents. Things take a turn after they get married to their respective partners.

metas.name: Brindavihari
metas.description: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

metas.name: Ee Bandhana
metas.description: Remake of  Hindi film Bhagban(2003), which itself is an unofficial adaptation of Make Way for Tomorrow (1937). An old couple sacrifices everything so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

metas.name: Aachar & Co
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of 1960s Bangalore, Aachar & Co. follows the journey of a traditional family as they navigate the challenges of embracing modernity while honouring their roots. The film brings together a delightful mix of nostalgia, humour, and drama, capturing the essence of that era.

metas.name: Ramanna Shamanna
metas.description: The film was a remake of Tamil film Chinna Thambi Periya Thambi.

metas.name: Malli Maduve
metas.description: A 1963 Kannada film starring Dr. Rajkumar in a lead role. It was the remake of 1949 Tamil film, Velaikaari.

metas.name: Margadarshi
metas.description: Margadarshi is a 1969 Kannada film that stars Dr. Rajkumar in a lead role.

metas.name: Nighatha
metas.description: A resentful young man refuses to let go of his anger and marries a woman to exact revenge from her family for their wrongdoings.

metas.name: Bharjari Gandu
metas.description: 1992 Kannada-language, romantic drama film directed by Renuka Sharma

metas.name: Thavarina Thottilu
metas.description: Thimanna, a conniving man, gets his son, Bhaskar, married to Sarsu, the sister of a rich landlord. Soon, Thimanna starts taking money from Sarsu by lying, but fate punishes his family in a harsh way.

metas.name: Halli Haida
metas.description: It is a remake of the 1973 Tamil film Pookkari.

metas.name: Belli Modagalu
metas.description: Belli Modagalu is a 1992 Kannada film directed by K V Raju and produced by Govinda G. The film stars Ramesh Aravind, Malashri, Doddanna and Avinash in lead roles. Music was composed by Upendrakumar.

metas.name: Thayigobba Karna
metas.description: Thayigobba Karna is a 1988 Kannada-language film directed by Raj Kishor.

metas.name: Halunda Tavaru
metas.description: A couple has to deal with the fact that they are not rich anymore and have to find inner strength to stick by each other's side in their times of trouble.

metas.name: Navashakthi Vaibhava
metas.description: Ramkumar and Shruthi who make lot of oaths for the betterment of their children (Master Ramprasad and Kumari Arpitha) and once the children become a pair of very talented singers, they forget everything about their promises. It is only when the kids suffer through a crucial illness that they are reminded of their oaths and the couple set out on a pilgrimage along with their children to all the nine goddesses – Kollur Mookambike, Badami Banashankeri, Mysore Chamundeswari, Belgaum Yallamma, Horanadu Annapurneshwari, Katilu Durgaparameshwari, Annamma Devi of Bangalore, Shringeri Sharadambe, Gokarna Parameshwari. There are also villains in the film in the form of the other family members who are bent upon killing the children.

metas.name: Ammana Mane
metas.description: Rajeeva, a partially-paralysed boy, is single-handedly brought up by his mother with great difficulty. As the years wear on, Rajeeva is faced with situations that test his devotion towards his mother.

metas.name: Punarjanma
metas.description: Punarjanma is a 1969 Kannada film which stars Dr. Rajkumar in a lead role.

metas.name: Bidugadeya Bedi
metas.description: Gowri, an egocentric girl, falls in love with Santharam, a school master. When Gowri's father is against their relationship, she tries to fight against all odds to unite with her lover.

metas.name: Swarna Samsara
metas.description: Shridhar, a happy and content bachelor, is forced to marry Chitralekha, an ambitious girl, under peer pressure. However, his penny-pinching attitude starts getting in the way of their marriage.

metas.name: Bhama Sathyabhama
metas.description: A husband disowns his wife when he comes to know that she is hard of hearing. The elders of the family decide to reunite them keeping their future in mind.

metas.name: Suvvi Suvvalali
metas.description: Chandana learns that she is infertile but her unmarried sister, Kasturi, promises that she can adopt her child when it is born. However, their lives turn upside down on the day of Kasturi's marriage.

metas.name: Rangasamudra
metas.description: In rural Karnataka an arrogant rich man publicly insults a beloved elder musician. The old man's grandson defiantly vows to teach him to drive, striving to restore his grandfather's dignity.

metas.name: Doddmane Hudga
metas.description: Surya, a boy belonging to a big family of the town, moves out of the house when ignored by his father Rajivappa. However, after a few years, he comes back to rescue his land against Babu, an evil man.

metas.name: Shubha Lagna
metas.description: Shubha Lagna is a 1995 Indian Kannada film, directed by Budal Krishnamurthy and produced by K Chidambara Shetty.

metas.name: Mallamana Pavaada
metas.description: Mallamana Pavaada is a 1969 Kannada film that stars Dr. Rajkumar in a lead role. It was directed by Puttana Kanagal

metas.name: Ananthu v/s Nusrath
metas.description: Ananthu is advocate belonging to an orthodox Brahmin family, who falls in Love with Nusrath Fathima baig, a Muslim girl. How Ananthu wins his love is the plot. Whole love story revolves in Court and Narrated in a humorous way.
